name: Dormant Recall Pool / 休眠召回池
generated_by: ChatGPT Work Mode assistant; exact runtime model ID not exposed
interaction_rules: Keep at most four versioned behavior capsules; mark at most one active and all other retained capsules dormant.
A new task cue selects only from currently observed capsule metadata; no future task or hidden truth is visible.
A matching dormant capsule pays a restore cost; a miss pays rebuild cost. Every reused capsule is still subject to task validation.
On a task-family switch, export and suspend the active capsule. Retention obeys a separate storage-budget eviction rule.
A capsule carries no reusable external credentials; activation must obtain current scoped authority.
emergent_properties: Separate active compute occupancy from retention duration: a rare capability can survive without remaining a running worker.
nearest_known_baseline: Equal-capacity warm LRU cache; equal-capacity all-cold cache with one transient execution; rebuild-on-demand.
expected_advantages: In sufficiently long recurring phases, lower ongoing active-state cost may outweigh extra restore cost relative to warm LRU.
expected_weaknesses: All-cold plus transient execution may be behaviorally identical.
Stale cues can recall an inappropriate version.
Snapshot and validation costs may dominate.
falsification: Reject the broad superiority claim if an equal-budget conventional baseline ties or dominates across the declared regimes.
Reject the proposed recurring-phase advantage if measured total cost does not fall versus warm LRU under the preregistered recurring workload.
Any correctness gain inferred solely from cost bookkeeping is invalid.

name: Locally Governed Reflex Mesh / 局部自治反射网
generated_by: ChatGPT Work Mode assistant; exact runtime model ID not exposed
interaction_rules: Each local program may process only its preassigned queue and resource slice without per-step central approval.
A service-side scope check rejects out-of-slice actions; ordinary success does not grant new permissions.
Observable budget violations create an auditable penalty proposal under a predeclared rule; accused actors cannot certify their own penalty.
Local peers may restrict only their own future interaction with an offender; a separate bounded appeal path handles disputed observations.
Shared irreversible actions still use a named authorization service; distributed action selection does not imply distributed trust roots.
emergent_properties: Local execution can continue during high-level latency, while repeated misuse affects future local participation.
nearest_known_baseline: Hierarchical controller with cached local policies; capability-limited worker pool with quotas and audit.
expected_advantages: Local decisions may reduce coordination messages during partial disconnection while preserving declared resource boundaries.
expected_weaknesses: Peer reports can be correlated or malicious.
Human penalty incentives may not transfer to model instances.
Appeals and identity persistence add overhead.
falsification: Reject if p95 latency fails to improve by 10% at equal correctness and budget.
Reject safety claim on any accepted out-of-scope action; measure false exclusions separately.
Reject claimed interaction benefit if removing internal penalties leaves all measured outcomes unchanged.

name: Budgeted Artifact Trail / 定额工件路径网
generated_by: ChatGPT Work Mode assistant; exact runtime model ID not exposed
interaction_rules: Actors read and write immutable, content-addressed work artifacts; routing indexes are separately versioned.
Local reuse observations raise candidate edge value; score aging removes confidence when evidence is stale.
Reinvest only a fixed index budget: creating or strengthening one route must account for the displaced route cost.
Retain an explicitly budgeted alternate route to prevent greedy pruning from destroying all reachability.
Artifact builders and index selectors exchange only validated receipts; success reports are capped to resist repeated self-reinforcement.
emergent_properties: Work products alter which subsequent tasks become cheap, and this future reuse changes where the index budget is spent.
nearest_known_baseline: Bounded shared artifact cache with usage-weighted adaptive routing; ant-inspired reinforcement with decay.
expected_advantages: Under shifting locality and limited index space, feedback-directed artifact placement may improve work reuse per storage unit.
expected_weaknesses: Early popularity crowds out rare work.
Edge changes can oscillate under delay.
Receipts can still be semantically wrong.
The structure may reduce exactly to an existing adaptive cache.
falsification: Reject if useful work per total cost improves less than 10% versus the strongest equal-budget baseline on held-out shifts.
Reject the emergence claim if static artifact placement with adaptive routing matches performance.
Count failures on rare and newly introduced tasks; average improvement cannot hide their collapse.
